Misattributed: the D-minor String Trio Op. 12 on the Centaur album 'Zellner & Perger: String Trios' is Richard von Perger's (IMSLP: String Trio, Op.12, D minor, 4 mvts Allegro moderato/Presto/Largo/Allegro vivace, publ. 1888; Zellner's Op. 12 is a piano concerto). Perger is not in the catalogue; his trio (c. 33 min) could be added under him.
IMSLP's work list names Op. 36 String Trio in C minor (Amadeus, 2003), 'recorded with von Perger's trio'; Concordia String Trio, Centaur 2017, 26:35. Composition year unknown.

IMSLP's scoring mismatch is only the per-piece groupings (instrDetail); the full nonet is flute, clarinet, bassoon, trumpet, 2 violins, viola, cello, piano. Nine pieces, 1929, Melodiya (Lazarev, 7:43) and Moscow Conservatory Records (2022).
MusicBrainz: 'Soul for String Quartet and Pipa', Shanghai Quartet and Min Xiao-Fen, The Flowing Stream (1998), 12:34. Year of composition not found.

Arcana album titles it 'Quartetto in B-flat major, Op. 2a No. 5' (4:39+3:39). 'Op. 2a' is IMSLP's way of telling apart two sets both printed as Op. 2 in 1779, so the opus stays; the print is undated (IMSLP n.d., ca. 1779), hence 'c. 1779'.
IMSLP: violin, cello, piano, five movements (Introduction et Allegro, Canon, Gavotte, Air, Gigue), Novello 1873, performed 1872 or earlier; Galos Piano Trio album 23:00 (own release).
